purpose: Test whether the independently validated v131 single-correction target can be predicted from deployment-visible K1 residuals and reported camera geometry across complete held-out PoolFire trajectories without increasing the exact 2A+2A^T budget.
scientific_question: Can one small odd permutation-equivariant pose-conditioned camera-set model predict the canonical detector correction delta_z well enough that exact lifting and observable scaling match zero-start CGLS K4 on every held-out trajectory?
claim_boundary: This is one primary-seed post-open development experiment on synthetic straight-ray BOS observations. A fit barrier is not a performance result. Even a held-out pass would not establish fresh external generalization, resource speedup, curved-ray performance, experimental BOST, an algorithm breakthrough, or paper success.

model.inputs: padded K1 residual [B,12,2,16,16], matching reported pose tokens [B,12,18], and camera mask [B,12]
model.architecture: the frozen v129 shared 2->8->12 camera encoder, 18->16->12 pose MLP, masked mean/max DeepSets context, shared 58->16->8->2 decoder and two odd skip gains; only the input/output semantics change
properties: exact zero padding outside the camera mask
no truth, future frame, trajectory identity or physical operator inside the model

outer_training.epoch_shuffle_rule: NumPy PCG64 seeded by fold_seed * 100000 + epoch
outer_training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch only; no held-out validation, early stopping, checkpoint ranking, ensemble or result-dependent retraining
outer_training.loss: mean per-sample squared relative-L2 of the canonical correction dual over active cameras

prediction_and_score.prediction_barrier: Only after all five checkpoints are sealed, a separate deployment-only runner may read each held-out K1 residual, reported pose and mask and atomically seal exactly 3700 correction predictions before any truth metric is computed.
prediction_and_score.candidate_shell: exact CGLS K1, predicted delta_z, one exact A^T lift, one exact A projection, unbounded observable least-squares scalar alpha, x=x1+alpha A^T delta_z; total 2A+2A^T

decision.if_primary_fails: Close the v131 residual-correction representation. Do not train no-pose siblings, replication seeds, larger CNN, FNO, UNO or U-Net models and do not run camera-subset, resource or external gates.
decision.if_primary_passes: Call it opened-fit mechanism headroom only. Then freeze replication seeds, non-nested random camera add/drop/reordering stress, fresh wall/RSS and one previously unopened public reaction-flow external condition in that order.
decision.real_data_gate: Experimental transfer still requires multi-camera displacement images, stable camera IDs and masks, per-camera intrinsics/extrinsics and coordinate conventions, repeat-noise information, and the laboratory-approved baseline.
